court: In the High Court of Madras
appellants: Axis Bank Ltd., Represented by its Authorised Signatory K. Thiyagarajan .…. Petitioner;
respondents: Inspector General of Registration and Others .…. Respondents.
advocates: For Petitioner: Mr. M.R. Uma Vijayan
For R1 & R2: Mr. T.M. Pappiah, Special Government Pleader
prayer: Prayer: Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, praying to issue Writ of Mandamus, forbearing the 1st and 2nd respondent from registering any documents/deeds/assignments and letters by alienating Plot No. 6, 7A & 7B in New Survey No. 127/14A1 & 127/14A2 (Old Survey No. 127/2, 80/5) admeasuring an extent of 5928.5 Sq.ft., situate at Noombal village, Registration District of South Chennai, by any of the respondents 3 to 6 in favour of any third party or financial institutions pursuant to the petitioner's representation dated 31.08.2019 followed by Notice dated 05.09.2019 issued by Central Crime Branch, Bank Fraud until petitioner's rights are legally safeguarded and pass orders.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

G. Jayachandran, J.:— Heard the Learned Counsel for the petitioner and the Learned Special Government Pleader for the respondents 1 and 2.

2. The Learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the respondents 1 & 2, states that pursuant to the communication received from the Police Inspector, Central Crime Branch - 1, Bank Fraud Wing Prevention Division addressed to Inspector General of Registration, Chennai, vide letter dated 05.09.2019, the Sub Registrar, has been instructed not to register any document pertaining to the subject property which is mortgaged with the petitioner/Axis Bank Ltd., by deposit of title deed.

3. Recording the said statement, the Writ Petition is disposed of. Since the prayer in the Writ Petition is complied. No costs. Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petition is closed.
